Pazapa English Programme for Adults Screen 1 of 5
Shopping for food

Listen once. What is the situation?

Écoutez une fois. Quelle est la situation ?

Listen again. Which words do you hear?

Écoutez encore. Quels mots entendez-vous ?

Listen again. Choose the correct details.

Écoutez encore. Choisissez les bons détails.

1. Where is the rice?

2. How many bottles of water does Amina want?

3. How much is the bread?

Listen once more. Put the three parts in order.

Écoutez une fois de plus. Mettez les trois parties dans l'ordre.

Use the arrows, or drag the cards, to put them in the correct order.

  • 1 Amina pays for the bread.
  • 2 Amina asks for rice and bread.
  • 3 Sara shows the milk and eggs.
Listening Mission complete.

You listened for key information about shopping for food.

Next, you will practise pronunciation.
